scripts.check:offline-fonts: node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const layout = readFileSync('app/layout.tsx', 'utf8'); const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); const lock = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package-lock.json', 'utf8')); const fonts = ['@fontsource-variable/inter', '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono', '@fontsource-variable/outfit']; if (layout.includes('next/font/' + 'google') || fonts.some((font) => !pkg.dependencies?.[font] || !lock.packages?.['node_modules/' + font])) throw new Error('Offline font configuration is incomplete');"
